lines: The stadium empties. The chant does not.
Ball Person scores once more, in an empty net.
He files the story before the cameras are off.
Blog Man writes the headline. It is about him.
Everyone else is on the floor.
Break never fell. Rule one still holds.
Three extra jumps. All of them used.
Cel lands last, and drawn best.
Six doors. Six choices.
Chooser picks the seventh. Nobody saw it.
The crossing is quiet now.
Crosser remembers every one who crossed him.
The numbers settle.
Probability of another fight: zero point zero.
One last record. No one asked.
DJ Won't Read drops it. Won't read the reviews.
The tower is quiet at dawn.
Evil Blue Bird tweets. The network listens.
The set goes dark behind him.
Exit Punk finds the door. It was never locked.
He read tomorrow's card yesterday.
Future Man was right again. Spoilers withheld.
The lights dim. Everyone is behind him.
Got Ur Back keeps his word. Nobody got past.
A flash on the bridge. Then nothing.
Kaelen was gone before the cameras turned.
The staff finds the path home.
Lapis Man walks it slowly. Respect, earned.
He owns the middle of the room.
Not an Old Man Yet. Still not yet.
The pit is full. The seats are not.
The Orchestrator raises the baton. The show goes on.
The encore starts in flames.
Pyro Singer opens and closes the night.
The belt stays on the chair.
Shark Dude bites. The belt isn't a belt.
The crowd waits for a word.
Shutup Bot says nothing. It is a very loud nothing.
A thin line across the wall.
Slice sheathes the blade. Clean, as promised.
Dust settles on an empty road.
Slow Rider takes the long way. No rush.
A small storm clears.
Small Weather's forecast: clear skies, for a minute.
Eight legs. All of them planted.
Spider Bot spins the finale. The net holds.
She sets it down. Gently.
SS Boulder wins. The boulder always wins.
The plates settle. The rubble does not.
Stratabots stands. Opponents cracked.
The light goes out, politely.
Susan prefers the dark. Stay in it.
The cameras are off. The stage is broken.
The Mechanic tightens the last bolt. Show's over.
He told them he'd try.
Try Belt tried. Twice. It counted.
Slow. Steady. Obviously.
TT finishes the match, then the chapter.
It looks up. Very calmly.
Uh Me. Done. Home by midnight.
Everyone is paid. Some twice.
Wallit clears the card, and the bill.
The progress bar fills. Finally.
Yo Bot: upload complete. Please clap.
Both eyes saw the end.
Yooba yooba. The mouth has the last word.
